t1.en: the passer-by should greet the one who is sitting

t2.en: greet [in return] with one better than it or [at least] return it

t1.en: 'Allahumma iftah li abwāba rahmatik' (O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy)

t2.en: 'Allahumma inni as’aluka min fadlik' (O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty)
and then invoke Allah's blessings upon me

t2.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلاَةِ القَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الوَسِيلَةَ وَالفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
t2.en: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer that is to be established, grant Muhammad Al-Wasīlah and Al-Fadīlah and resurrect him to the Praiseworthy Station that You have promised him

t1.en: let him eat with his right hand

t2.ar: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنِي هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
t2.en: Alhamdulillah al-ladhi at‘amani hadha wa razaqneih min ghayri hawl li wala quwwah (Praise be to Allah who fed me and provided me with this food through no might or power on my part)

t1.en: 'yarhamuk Allah' (may Allah have mercy on you)

t2.en: he should say 'alhamdu-lillāh' (praise be to Allah)
'yahdīkum Allah wa yuslih bālakum!' (may Allah guide you and grant you well being)

t1.en: When one mentions Allah's name upon entering his house

t2.en: and eat from what is nearer to you

t1.ar: لا بأس؛ طَهُور إن شاء الله
t1.en: No harm, (it will be) purification (from sins) if Allah wills

t1.ar: إنَّ لِلَّه ما أَخَذ ولَهُ ما أَعطَى، وكلُّ شَيءٍ عِنده بِأجَل مُسمَّى فَلتَصبِر ولتَحتَسِب
t1.en: To Allah belongs what He takes, and to Him belongs what He gives, and for everything He sets a specific term. So she should have patience and seek the reward from Allah

t2.en: Indeed we belong to Allāh, and indeed to Him we will return

t1.ar: الْإِسْلَامُ أَنْ تَشْهَدَ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ، وَتُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةَ، وَتُؤْتِيَ الزَّكَاةَ، وَتَصُومَ رَمَضَانَ، وَتَحُجَّ الْبَيْتَ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا
t1.en: Islam is to testify that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, to establish prayer, to pay Zakah, to fast Ramadan, and to perform Hajj to the House if you are able to find a way thereto

t2.ar: فَادْعُهُمْ إِلَى أَنْ يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللهِ
t2.en: invite them to testify that none is worthy of worship except Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah

t1.en: Whoever of you comes to attend the Friday prayer, let him take a shower

t2.en: Get up and pray two Rak‘ahs
listens to it attentively and keeps silent

t1.en: Have Sahūr (pre-dawn meal) for, indeed, there is a blessing in Sahūr

t1.ar:
مــن طلــوع الفجــر 
إلــى غــروبِ الشــمسِ

t2.ar: مَنْ نَسِيَ وَهُوَ صَائِمٌ، فَأَكَلَ أَوْ شَرِبَ، فَلْيُتِمَّ صَوْمَهُ
t2.en: Whoever forgets while fasting and eats or drinks, let him complete his fast
